Application Data.NAME: Colorful Creations Paint and Wallpaper Store
Application Data.GL CODE: Paint and Wallpaper Store GL Code: 9998
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Colorful Creations Paint and Wallpaper Store specializes in providing a wide range of high-quality paints, wallpapers, and decorative supplies to homeowners and contractors. We offer personalized consultations to help customers choose the right products for their projects, as well as a variety of tools and accessories for painting and wallpapering. Our store also features seasonal promotions and workshops to educate customers on painting techniques and home decor trends. We prioritize customer satisfaction and strive to create a vibrant and welcoming shopping experience.

Underwriting Guidelines:
Preferred Optional Coverages
• Business Interruption: Protects against loss of income resulting from covered property
damage events, such as fire or flood, which may temporarily close the store.
• Theft and Pollution Liability: Theft coverage is important due to the high value and
theft-prone nature of paint and wallpaper inventory. Pollution liability coverage addresses
accidental chemical spills or leaks that may cause environmental damage.
